root_causes.summary: Legacy status / gap bridge emitted priority actions without authoritative satisfied truth
root_causes.detail: derive_gaps_from_legacy_requirement_row and Mongo gap queries keyed on status PENDING/MISSING even when enriched truth_presentation_stage was verified or declaration_recorded.

root_causes.summary: Command Centre primary stream used runtime projection without full enrich
root_causes.detail: fetch_client_priority_actions_primary called project_requirement_row_client_runtime instead of enrich_requirements_for_client, omitting truth_presentation_stage and suppressed take_action.
VALID/VERIFIED rows with stale PENDING status or incomplete evidence_completeness flags still passed lifecycle guard; did not consult truth_presentation_stage or evidence_authority VERIFIED_CURRENT.
Did not suppress tasks when take_action.suppressed or authoritative satisfied truth applied.

root_causes.summary: Operational surface cache invalidation not wired on authority sync
root_causes.detail: invalidate_unified_tasks_for_client existed but was never called after evidence authority sync, allowing stale Today/CC tasks for up to TTL (~45s).
